resolved_questions: Use existing TCard canonical definition; add default constructor and actual virtual destructor out of line in TCardLifecycle.cpp. Retain independent tagged borrowed-state constructor. Add optional owned CardState and optional real CCL/SPI response runtime before reference members, plus independent registration flag. Do not copy ARM byte offsets as host layout.

Default state sets observedWord14 to 0xffffffff, every observed word18..44 and 4c..58 to zero, byte48 to zero; opaque2c/opaque5c null and word30 zero. Original offset10 is also 0xffffffff but declaration/meaning unresolved: keep explicit observedWord10 projection rather than inventing a field type.

Initialize SysexReceiver using existing implementation. Bind real CCL-backed response clock/sleep and SPI idle, diagnostics to spiServiceConstructionIO; no copied legacy Core classes. Mirror existing Router lifecycle composition while keeping canonical Card-specific runtime name.

Default constructor invokes TCardSPI::instance().registerReceiver(this); destructor of a default-owned instance invokes TCardSPI::instance().unRegisterReceiver(this), even if singleton has been cleared and lazily recreated. Tagged borrowed compatibility setup never registers and must not unregister borrowed state.

Use compiler-emitted C1/C2/D0/D1/D2 symbols. Native C1/C2 and D1/D2 are distinct addresses, not aliases. D0 has a real call to _ZdlPv at 0x9d3b4 after unregister; D1/D2 never delete the card object. Deleting cleanup must be observed from native instruction execution with allocator hook in subsequent reconstruction, not synthesized as a log event.

Current class updateFirmware remains pure until separate update reconstruction integrates. Constructors/destructors can be built and exercised via a derived test class implementing the existing pure member; do not add a fake updateFirmware body to make the class concrete. Root must verify compiler emits each original variant independently.
unresolved_declarations: Original unencoded ordinary returns/private field declarations/layout remain unresolved; bounded source-port choices only.
data.dependencies_inclusion_plan: Existing canonical app providers and pinned CCL; no new external app reconstruction required. Lifecycle variants share one class/file and must be assigned to one worker; Root integrates build partition.
data.oracle_plan: Later approved bounded ARM execution of each exact original range; finite allocator/new/delete, registration and CCL provider boundaries only, no device syscall passthrough. Test existing/newly lazy SPI singleton paths, full initialized application-state writes and unchanged unspecified bytes; separate constructor variants, D1/D2 unregister with no card free, D0 actual native delete target once, constructor allocation-failure cleanup. Compare actual C++ registration vector and instrumented operator delete behavior; verify each compiled ELF name. Test tagged borrowed overload separately as an intentional compatibility domain.
